summary: Tested custom pages functionality from JourneyStepsPage. All 5 requested features work correctly: (1) Items on custom pages have correct icons (not pins), (2) Clicking items navigates to content, (3) Drag & drop creates groups, (4) Pins in JourneyStepsPage display section content, (5) Back button returns with section expanded. Found bug: Layout API returns 401 on page load because HomeLayoutProvider loads before authentication.

integration_issues.issue: HomeLayoutProvider loads and calls /api/user/layout before authentication is complete, causing 401 errors. Custom pages are not persisted across browser sessions.

action_items: Fix HomeLayoutProvider to wait for authentication before loading layout. Options: (1) Move HomeLayoutProvider inside ProtectedRoute, (2) Add auth check in loadLayout function, (3) Use auth context to trigger layout load after login
critical_code_review_comments: HomeLayoutContext.js line 85-109: loadLayout() is called in useEffect with empty deps, which runs on mount before auth. Should check for token validity first or wait for auth state.
App.js line 119: HomeLayoutProvider wraps entire app including auth page, causing premature API calls

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 5 features work correctly in single session

seed_data_creation: Created test pages during testing: 'Test Icons Page', 'Click Test Page', 'Group Test', 'DnD Test', 'DnD Final' - these are not persisted due to the 401 bug
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom pages functionality works correctly within a single browser session. The main issue is that the layout is not persisted across sessions because HomeLayoutProvider calls /api/user/layout before the user is authenticated. The backend API works correctly (verified with curl). Features tested: (1) ITEM_ICONS mapping in DragDropComponents.jsx correctly shows icons like 🎁, 🤰, ✨ instead of 📌, (2) DraggableItem handleClick navigates using ITEM_ROUTES, (3) createGroupFromItems in HomeLayoutContext creates groups via drag & drop, (4) JourneyStepsPage pin toggle expands sections showing SECTION_ITEMS, (5) Back navigation preserves expanded state via ?open= URL parameter.

custom_page_icons.details: Items show correct icons from ITEM_ICONS mapping (🎁, 🤰, ✨) not pins (📌)

item_click_navigation.details: Clicking items navigates to correct routes from ITEM_ROUTES (/section/pregnancy, /scanner)

drag_drop_groups.details: Dragging item onto another triggers prompt and creates group with 'Groupe créé!' toast

pin_section_expand.details: Clicking pin expands section showing 6 items with correct icons

back_button_preserves_state.details: Back button returns to JourneyStepsPage with section still expanded (6 items visible)

layout_persistence.details: Layout not persisted across sessions due to 401 error on /api/user/layout during initial load

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Layout API returns 401 on page load
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: HomeLayoutProvider is mounted at App.js level (line 119) and calls loadLayout() in useEffect on mount (HomeLayoutContext.js line 85-109). At this point, the token may not be in localStorage yet or the auth state is not ready.
reproduction_steps: 1. Open app in new browser session
3. Observe console: 'Erreur chargement layout: AxiosError' with 401 status
4. Create custom page and add items
5. Refresh page - custom page is gone
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Move HomeLayoutProvider inside protected routes or add auth state check before calling loadLayout()
